name: KEPCO Naju Integrated ICT Center (Phase 1)
notes: Uptime Institute lists KEPCO's Naju Integrated ICT Center Phase 1 (Naju-si) with Tier III design/constructed-facility certification (official award record, A for existence). Korean trade press reports KEPCO's Naju HQ data center accommodates servers/storage computing systems with about 8MW power capacity, and KEPCO ran a fire-response joint drill at the Naju data center in Nov 2026 (article month) - corroborating operational status.

name: NHN Enterprise Suncheon Public Cloud Data Center
developer: NHN Enterprise / NHN Cloud with Jeollanam-do and Suncheon City
notes: 2021 MOU (KRW 300bn, 20-year) for a public cloud data center and smart IT valley in Suncheon; site finalized 2022 with 2024 completion originally targeted. ETNews (Feb 2024) reports construction stalled for 3 years over contractor/cost issues; Yonhap (Nov 2024) reports nearly 4 years with no groundbreaking; 2026 reporting still shows no construction start. Status kept planned (delayed).

name: SolaSeaDo RE100 Data Center Campus
developer: Bosung Group / The Green Korea (EIP-Diode Ventures)
notes: Project described as five 40MW renewable-powered data centers in SolaSeaDo (2023-2030). SolaSeaDo is the Yeongam-Haenam tourism/leisure enterprise city; the Solaseado Data Center Park parcels are located in Haenam-gun Sanimyeon, so division assignment to Yeongam-gun reflects the cross-county enterprise-city footprint (Haenam entries carry the park-specific projects). 2026 local reporting questions Yeongam's share as the Solaseado DC plan shifts toward Haenam.

name: KT Cheongju IDC
notes: Colocation directory sources list KT Cheongju IDC in Cheongju-si; Datacenters.com reports access to 20MW of power. No current official KT capacity page found; directory-only evidence (C).

name: Daecheong Dam Hydrothermal Specialized Data Center Cluster
notes: The Daecheong Dam hydrothermal-energy specialized district (about 200,000 pyeong) was selected in MOLIT's '2026 Investment-Leading District' public contest on 2026-06-30 (official designation; KHARN/local coverage). District will supply hydrothermal energy for cooling loads of 4 x 40MW-class (160MW total) data centers plus smart farms and industry; K-water MOU with Chungbuk and Cheongju signed 2024-07-03. Data center part remains at district-planning stage.

name: KATI Chungju Data Center (Dongchungju Industrial Complex)
developer: Powerlink Co., Ltd.; LG CNS; POSCO E&C; POSCO ICT
notes: Powerlink held the groundbreaking ceremony (gigongsik) for the KATI Chungju data center at Dongchungju Industrial Complex, Sancheok-myeon - reported as the largest data center in the central region (receiving capacity max 80MW, site 23,345 sqm, floor area 42,496 sqm). Local reporting confirms construction is underway; IT load earlier reported at 48MW.

name: POSCO ICT Chungju Cloud Data Center
notes: POSCO ICT announced launch of its Chungju cloud data center on 2012-10-18 (site 12,758 sqm, gross floor area 7,742 sqm); KDCC green-certification page corroborates. Public MW capacity not found.

name: SK Group Chungju AI Data Center Candidate Site
notes: MK reported SK Group officials inspected Chungju Dream Park Industrial Complex as one candidate for a Chungcheong-area 1GW AI data center. Still under internal review across multiple candidate sites; status unknown and capacity reflects the regional target rather than a committed Chungju allocation.

name: Naver second data center Eumseong / Chungbuk Innovation City candidate site
developer: Naver; Chungcheongbuk-do and Eumseong-gun as site promoters
notes: Eumseong/Chungbuk Innovation City was one of ten shortlisted sites visited for Naver's second data center in 2019; Naver ultimately built GAK Sejong, so this candidate is treated as not selected. No new Eumseong datacenter activity found in this round.

name: Jecheon Internet Data Center, 4th Industrial Complex
developer: Welcome Asset Management consortium; Jecheon-si; Chungcheongbuk-do
notes: Jecheon and Chungcheongbuk-do signed an MOU (2023-07-03) for the 'Jecheon Internet Data Center' in the planned 4th Industrial Complex: receiving capacity 40MW, about KRW 600bn, completion target 2026-2027. Industrial-complex approval was applied for with Chungbuk; no construction confirmation found.

name: Jecheon renewable-energy data center, 4th Industrial Complex
developer: Valmax Technology; Fine Asset Management; Namsa Dream Energy; Jecheon-si
notes: Jecheon signed an investment agreement for a KRW 500bn eco-friendly renewable-energy data center in the 4th Industrial Complex: 60,600 sqm site, 20MW scale using solar, biogas and biomass energy. Separate project from the Welcome Asset Management 40MW IDC.

name: NAVER Data Center GAK Sejong (incl. 2nd/3rd phase AI expansion)
notes: GAK Sejong (Buyong-myeon) launched 2023-11-08 and is operational; NAVER started phase 2/3 construction at end-2025, acquiring 60,000 next-gen Blackwell GPUs and targeting 270MW total campus scale by 2029 as Asia's largest AI hub (AI factory capacity cited growing from 55MW to 200MW+; campus total 270MW per DCD/DataCenterMap). Official NAVER release (A) plus ETNews/Hankyung (B) coverage.

name: Okestro Cloud Sejong Finance Center II data center
notes: Sejong and Okestro Cloud signed a 2025 MOU for a KRW 700bn data center in the vacant Sejong Finance Center II building (up to 40MW, 2027 target); a 2026 local report says the plan was scrapped, so recorded as rejected/cancelled.
